sources.source_name: Microsoft: Microsoft Announces Record First Quarter Revenue
sources.notes: Microsoft said more than 67 million Windows XP licenses had sold since the October 25, 2001 launch.
Cisco reported Q3 FY2001 sales of $4.73 billion versus $4.93 billion a year earlier, a $2.2 billion excess-inventory charge, and a $2.69 billion GAAP net loss.
Amazon reported 2003 net sales of $5.264 billion, up 34%, and net income of $35 million after a $149 million net loss in 2002.
